Barry Rosenstein decreased its stake in Pandora Media Inc (P) by 47.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by Barry Rosenstein held 8.56 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $41.26M, down from 16.32 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jana Partners Llc who had been investing in Pandora Media Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.40 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.37% or $0.02 $5.47.
